name: Vega de Tirados (Spain)
description: Square yellow flag with a red chevron lying on its side with its point towards the fly, charged with yellow stars, the hoist triangle bearing five blue wavy vertical stripes.
history: The arms of Vega de Tirados were approved on 15 November 2016 and the municipal flag on 11 November 2016, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 29 December 2016; the flag is square, of proportions 1:1, yellow with a red chevron lying on its side, and in the hoist triangle five blue wavy vertical stripes that do not touch the chevron.
